user.title: NeonPlan own pack keys
user.description: Registers your own Ed25519 public keys in NeonPlan 3D so self-signed furniture packs can be imported. Keys are managed afterwards via the integration's Configure button.

add.title: Add public key
add.description: Add an Ed25519 public key (as printed by `fp3dpack.py keygen`) to NeonPlan 3D's trusted publishers.

generated.title: Signing key created
generated.description:
The private key was saved to `{path}` — keep it secret and back it up; `fp3dpack.py sign --key {path}` signs packs with it.

Public key `{key_id}` (`{public_key}`) will be registered when you submit.

error.invalid_key_id: Key ID must be 12 lowercase hex characters
error.invalid_public_key: Not a valid base64-encoded 32-byte Ed25519 public key
